India Panel Proposes Simulator-Heavy Pilot License Amid Crew Shortage

An Indian panel has proposed a new pilot license system that would rely heavily on simulator training to address a shortage of airline crew. Airlines have been asked to provide feedback on the plan. Following this consultation, the committee is expected to submit its final report to the head of the regulatory body. This initiative aims to streamline pilot training and potentially increase the availability of qualified pilots for the aviation sector.
